description: WRITE: add an INTERNAL note (visible to staff, not sent to the customer) to an order, or to one line item with order_line_id. Each call adds a new note, so do not repeat it. POST /api/json/manage_orders/add_internal_note.

order_id.description: The order's invoice number, e.g. INV1234 (this is the order id).

order_line_id.description: Attach the note to this line item instead of the order.

name: deconetwork_add_order_note
title: Add internal note to order

description: One order by invoice number with everything the API holds: all line items with decoration views/areas/processes, fields and sizes, team names, payments, refunds, shipments with tracking and packages, notes, taxes, store, and (optional) workflow items and purchase-order data. Status codes are spelled out. Card numbers, coupons and credential-bearing document/media links are removed. Supplier catalog tools are unavailable. GET /api/json/manage_orders/find (invoice number condition).

include_po_data.description: Include purchase orders linked to the workflow items (implies workflow data).

include_production_file_info.description: Include production file format, size and offsets per decoration.

include_workflow_data.description: Include production workflow items (what is left to produce or ship).

order_id.description: The order's invoice number, e.g. INV1234 (this is the order id).

name: deconetwork_get_order
title: Get order

description: Orders due in a date window (default: the next 7 days from today, UTC), soonest first, as compact summaries. By default cancelled, deleted and already shipped orders are left out, so the list is the work still ahead; set include_closed to see them. Use to answer 'what has to ship this week?'. GET /api/json/manage_orders/find (date due condition).

include_closed.description: Also return shipped, cancelled and deleted orders.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

name: deconetwork_list_orders_due
title: List orders due

description: Search DecoNetwork orders by date ordered, date due, date shipped, date invoiced or date modified (each a from/to range) and/or invoice number. Conditions are ANDed; with no filter the last 30 days of orders (by date ordered) are returned. Returns a compact summary per order: invoice number (order_id), job name, order and payment status in words, dates, amounts, billing and ship-to contact, shipping method, tracking numbers and line items. Use deconetwork_get_order for everything on one order. order_status narrows the page after it is fetched (the vendor has no documented status filter), so it must be combined with a date range or invoice number; page with next_offset. Max 100 rows per call; total and next_offset page through the rest. GET /api/json/manage_orders/find.

due_from.description: Orders due on or after this UTC date.

due_to.description: Orders due on or before this UTC date.

include_shipments.description: Also load shipments (tracking, packages). Tracking numbers are listed either way when loaded.

invoice_number.description: Only the order with exactly this invoice number.

invoiced_from.description: Orders invoiced on or after this UTC date.

invoiced_to.description: Orders invoiced on or before this UTC date.

modified_from.description: Orders changed on or after this UTC date.

modified_to.description: Orders changed on or before this UTC date.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

order_status.description: Keep only orders in these statuses (applied to the fetched page): ready for production, ready for shipping, shipped, cancelled, deleted, on hold, awaiting purchase order, awaiting stock, awaiting artwork.

ordered_from.description: Orders placed on or after this UTC date (date ordered).

ordered_to.description: Orders placed on or before this UTC date (a bare date means end of that day).

shipped_from.description: Orders shipped on or after this UTC date.

shipped_to.description: Orders shipped on or before this UTC date.

name: deconetwork_search_orders
title: Search orders

description: WRITE: move a whole order, one line item or part of a line item to 'produced' or 'shipped'. Cannot be undone through the API. With new_status shipped you can store a tracking number (shipping_code). contact_customer=true makes DecoNetwork EMAIL THE CUSTOMER about the change (only when the whole order changes status); it defaults to false, so set it only when the user asked to notify the customer. Give order_line_id to change one line, plus workflow_item_id (and optionally qty) to change part of it. POST /api/json/manage_orders/update_order_status.

contact_customer.description: Email the customer about this change (default false). Whole-order changes only.

operator_login.description: Login of the operator to credit (default: the connected staff account).

order_id.description: The order's invoice number, e.g. INV1234 (this is the order id).

order_line_id.description: Only this line item (omit for the whole order).

qty.description: Quantity to move; needs workflow_item_id. Default: the outstanding quantity.

shipping_code.description: Tracking number to store when marking shipped.

workflow_item_id.description: Only this workflow item of the line (see deconetwork_get_order with include_workflow_data).

name: deconetwork_update_order_status
title: Mark order produced or shipped
